text: The project features an end-to-end, inclusive early warning system design with a binational scope, aligning with national Early Warnings for All (EW4All) roadmaps. It emphasizes strengthening the four pillars of early warning systems: risk knowledge, monitoring and warning services, dissemination and communication, and response capability. The project is regionally networked via the WMO Regional Forecast Support Centre in Ha Noi and is set to continue into a second phase (CREWS 2.0) after its initial completion in 2025.

metadata.solution_name: Reinforcing the capacities of meteorological and hydrological services and enhancing the early warning systems in Cambodia and Lao PDR (CREWS Cambodia and Lao PDR)
